bullets.text: Notepad Gets Major Update - **Microsoft** introduces table support and AI text features in Notepad for Windows Insiders.
Windows 11 Insider Preview Released - New build 26220.7271 adds Xbox full screen experience and point-in-time restore features.
Microsoft Named Leader Again - **Microsoft** recognized as a leader in the 2025 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Access Management.
Holiday PC Buying Guide - **Microsoft** highlights top Windows 11 PCs and deals for the holiday season.
AI Innovations at Ignite 2025 - **Microsoft** showcases advancements in AI and security at Ignite, emphasizing agentic capabilities.
Edge for Business Launched - **Microsoft** unveils the first secure enterprise AI browser, enhancing productivity and security.
New AI Features in Azure - **Microsoft** announces Azure Copilot and AI infrastructure innovations to modernize cloud operations.
Microsoft Foundry Expands - **Microsoft** Foundry introduces new models, enhancing AI capabilities for developers on Azure.
